name: Alien Animal Creation Table
description: p.110. Roll 2D plus the terrain DM to generate a unique alien creature. Terrain DM: Open Country +0; Shrubland, Wetland, or Aquatic +1; Forest/Jungle +2; Arctic -3; Desert -2; Mountainous -1; Exotic +1/-1*; Subterranean +3/-3*. *Alternating Trait Generation DM: alternate rolling the positive and negative DM every trait roll. Then roll 1D for Behaviour as listed in the row, and roll on the Characteristics table for that behaviour and on the Alien Animal Traits table the listed number of times.

name: Alien Animal Characteristics (Herbivore)
description: p.111. Characteristics Table, Herbivore column. Roll 1D for an animal whose behaviour is Herbivore. When the animal notices the spacer, roll 2D and compare to the Flee, Ignore, and Fight ranges.

results.text: Characteristic: Filter · Flee: 5 or less · Ignore: n/a if in range · Fight: 6+
